snippet.title: Outbreak Zero – Official Trailer (2025) | New Survival Horror Game - PC
snippet.description:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669190/Outbreak_Zero/
Epic Store : https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/outbreak-zero-c7f0ca

Story ,
A zombie outbreak starts at a subway station just as a train is about to leave. People run for their lives, trying to escape the chaos. Now, you must find out how the virus started and if there’s a way to stop it. As you explore the dark tunnels and abandoned streets, danger lurks around every corner. Resources are limited, and every decision matters. Will you survive long enough to uncover the truth behind the virus's rapid spread?

-----

Gameplay features
Rich action and interaction design

Puzzles

inventory management

Save Room and Item Storage

All types of enemies from blood thirsty zombies, mutated fauna to other nightmare fuel creatures

In game unlockable

Immersive OST inspired by the Classics

Detailed visual rendering

Multiple weapons and equipment system,
